metadata.title: AI RMF GOVERN Function Example Profile for Demonstration and Testing

remarks.p: This example demonstrates include-controls with a matching pattern that selects one of the AI RMF functions in full, resolved with flat structuring. Paired with the categories-only example, which uses as-is structuring over the same catalog, the two illustrate the difference between the two structuring directives. The selection is illustrative and is not a NIST-recommended, required, or otherwise normative AI RMF baseline.
